caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered horizontally on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to be a length of twisted, rope-like material with a loop at the left end. The rope is rendered in shades of brown and tan, with the twisting strands clearly defined along the object’s length. On the right side of the drawing, the rope ends in a smaller, curled-up section. The artist’s signature, “MARYE HANSEN,” is written in small, capital letters in the lower right portion of the image. There are no other objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Horse Hobble
